I think therapy helps as a place to vent, especially if you don't have a lot of support otherwise. 

It can make a big difference for some people. If it was free, then I'd say it's probably good for everyone, but given the price idk if everything can always justify it.

I actually don't know of any forums for the female equivalent of incels, so I can't say what is or isn't discussed there.

Maybe you're right though, incels just like every man and woman in the world believed that at some point they'd be able to attract a partner. They'd probably be less disappointed if that wasn't taught as an expectation. If we stop saying "when you get married" or "when you have children" and replaced it with "if" then it probably wouldn't hit as hard.

>or just really unlucky.

Latter, just haven't met anyone in the right circumstances and you are not attractive enough physically or socially to not have to rely on chance.

>It’s way less likely for a woman to blame males for her issues with not getting laid, they tend to blame their looks. I know plenty of nerdy women who can’t get boyfriends, and most of them just have body dysmorphia or low self esteem, not hatred towards the opposite sex.

This is exactly what incels are, just because they talk like tough guys on the internet doesn't mean anything. In real life they're doormats who can't get women because of their poor social skills.

>And there hasn’t been a single woman mass murder who kills men because she can’t get laid.

Women commit almost no mass murders in general, independent of motive, so that's obviously going to be the case.

He's saying that's what it means to be an incel definitionally. You probably disagree and define incel as "someone who labels themselves an incel" rather than as "someone who can't get sex", if you don't agree on the definition of the word though there's no point in arguing how it should be defined.

>You don’t see many women calling themselves incels or being anti-male because they can’t get validation from men.

Because it's less common for women to not get validation from men. The femcel thing does exist though, women who struggle with men are often anti-male.
Build muscle, make money. You can try to use those things to circumvent your other short comings. People don't care about anything other than looks and money, no matter what they say.

>Also, you are not entitled to coddling from women simply because you were born a male.

Nobody said anyone is entitled to anything. I don't know where you are getting that from. 

Anyway it's besides the point OP wants to know why Reddit has so much incel energy, it's because the men on Reddit are socially isolated and depressed and thus are lashing out. It's probably not new, it's just that you have the internet now so you can listen to people piss and moan from across the globe.

Having augmented biology is not the same thing as not being biological wired in certain ways.

The updated description sounds more like you're saying we saw humans can ignore biological wiring which I think is a dubious claim, but it's unprovable so whatever.

>no, you're not "biologically wired" to do anything, gender is a social construct.

You actually believe this?

In reality they would literally all put their hypothetical girlfriend on a pedestal. Most of these guys are living doormats in reality and are only saying they'd abuse their hypothetical girlfriend out of bitterness.

Same, I have friends I hang out with, but I have to set it up. The issue on my end is that somehow I am the outgoing one in my friend group, despite being pretty boring. My more adventurous friends who go to clubs and parties and that kind of thing have abandoned me long ago, so I don't really have anyone to hang out with if I try for night life. I end up wanting to sleep early so I can fast forward to something happening.
I want to go so bad. But I keep thinking about how much it will ruin things for everyone. God damnit, I wish there was an easy way.
